title: Arioch
summary: Raleigh names Arioch in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). King of Ellassar, one of the four kings Abraham overthrew. A later Arioch, who commanded under Nebuchadnezzar, is named in the same chapter and was not made a second record. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
